def get_cached_or_evaluated_value(ws_values, ws_formula, cell_ref):
    """Return the displayed value of a cell where possible, evaluating the simple concat formulas used here if needed."""
    val = ws_values[cell_ref].value
    if val is not None:
        return val

    formula = ws_formula[cell_ref].value
    if not (isinstance(formula, str) and formula.startswith("=")):
        return formula

    # Minimal evaluator for formulas like =1&" - "&F2 or =2&" - "&F22
    expr = formula[1:]
    parts = expr.split("&")
    out = ""
    for part in parts:
        part = part.strip()
        if len(part) >= 2 and part[0] == '"' and part[-1] == '"':
            out += part[1:-1]
        elif re.fullmatch(r"\d+", part):
            out += part
        elif re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z]{1,3}\d+", part):
            ref_val = ws_values[part].value
            if ref_val is None:
                ref_val = ws_formula[part].value
            out += "" if ref_val is None else str(ref_val)
        else:
            return formula
    return out

def extract_outcome(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        value = str(value)

    text = value

    # Remove only a leading numbered marker such as "1 - " or "23 - ".
    text = re.sub(r"^\d+ - ", "", text, count=1)

    # Remove the trailing portion after the final " - " (the ID portion).
    if " - " in text:
        text = text.rsplit(" - ", 1)[0]

    return text

wb_values = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path, data_only=True)
ws_values = wb_values["Here"]

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path, data_only=False)
ws = wb["Here"]

for row in range(2, 7):
    source_value = get_cached_or_evaluated_value(ws_values, ws, f"I{row}")
    if source_value is not None and source_value != "":
        ws[f"J{row}"] = extract_outcome(source_value)
